# Contract v1 fixtures

These are synthetic, redacted wire-shape fixtures: DSH Connection examples are source-verified against installed DSH 0.1.7-rc.2; `pair-*` and `info-*` pin the dsh-remote access schema. They are not captures from a live Host. The session/list response includes only official cold-safe summary fields and synthetic IDs/paths. The deterministic pairing token is test data only. `contract-v1.json` and every JSON fixture are duplicated byte-for-byte in dsh-mobile so both implementations consume one contract ID and identical samples.

The binary cases store an edge-case byte vector as hex beside the official Connection metadata shape or raw-upload request; they are not hand-authored multipart bodies with fake boundaries. The production plugin carrier has passed an isolated macOS DSH Host round-trip for pairing/info, workspace/session creation, multipart `readBytes`, raw upload, and official approval/user-question service waterfalls. The real-Host probe exercises per-delivery `next`, terminal-result cancellation, Host-signal cancellation, and pending-question replay on a new event generation; approval is called directly under a probe-opened turn, not generated by a model/tool call. This does not imply iOS device, Windows, Linux, full model/tool execution, or load compatibility. No user prompt, host path, or real session data is present here.

`stream-open.workspace-follow.json` and `workspace-follow.*.json` pin the official workspace-follow open payload, complete baseline, and each ordered increment shape. These fixtures are shared byte-for-byte with the iOS repository; isolated production-carrier baseline/upsert and fresh-connection baseline evidence is tracked separately from these synthetic samples.

`rpc-response.settings-describe.json` pins the selected secrets-free default-model and permission namespace views. The settings mutation request/result samples preserve the official `ns`/`ops`/`expectedRevision` form and `settings/conflict` details. Their synthetic values do not enable the production plugin's settings write policy; the real Host probe separately verifies a redacted descriptor and CAS success/conflict in a disposable profile.

The synthetic `waterfall-event.*.json` fixtures pin normalized approval and question frames observed through the official services; the probe substitutes stable IDs and compares the live frame structure with these samples.

Run the fixture-shape checks with `node --test test/contract-v1.test.mjs`. These tests validate only the committed examples; run `test/run-m0-host-probe.sh` for the isolated real-Host checks.
